Sanders and Bannon Call for AI Safety Measures

US Senator Bernie Sanders and former White House advisor Steve Bannon have jointly called for greater safety measures regarding artificial intelligence (AI). Both figures have expressed concerns about the rapid development of AI technology and its potential implications. Their joint appeal highlights a rare alignment on the issue of AI regulation and safety protocols.
